messages:
irene: Need a compact decision: how do we ship streaming so customers get useful partials but we keep ops risk low? Outline: resume modes, finish_reason set, and what we gate at launch.

omar: TL;DR: support SSE for broad compatibility + optional WS for Dedicated. Resume: three modes (off, token-based soft resume, full state restore). Soft resume returns last_seq only; full restores KV.

jun: Runtime constraints: full restore requires persisted KV snapshot per stream (costly). Suggest default to soft-resume for Hosted, full-resume only for Dedicated with opt-in. If token invalid, server should emit a finish with reason `resume_unavailable`.

maria: From customers: they want a clear final signal and deterministic function-call completion. Propose finish_reason enum v1 = ["completed","cancelled","error","resume_unavailable","function_call_pending"]. Document UI behaviours for each.

irene: Delta shape (v1): single-line JSON per chunk, always includes seq. Example: {"type":"delta","seq":42,"kind":"content|function|finish","payload":{...}}. Clients dedupe by seq on reconnect.

omar: Function semantics: default = deferred (server emits a `function` kind at finish). Inline partial args is a Dedicated opt-in flag because it complicates resume.

jun: Telemetry & canary gates: resume_attempts, resume_success_rate >=99.5%, 95p tail latency no worse than baseline +5%. Rollout: feature-flagged, 7-day canary in Dedicated eu-west-1, then staged hosted launch with soft-resume only.

immediate-actions: omar -> draft SDK example + seq dedupe snippet; jun -> runtime cost estimate for KV snapshots; maria -> customer MUST list for finish semantics. ops-bot: created INF-8044: streaming-resume-fallbacks.
